results.headline: Preliminary Results Confirm 74% Copper Recovery
results.key_quote: This programme set out to show whether we could extract enough copper from the stockpiled material at Molulu, and at 74% it has done just that. The fact that this work was carried out with a potential offtake partner is, in our view, an encouraging sign of the Projects' potential and supports the next phase of exploration. However, we are mindful that these are early-stage preliminary results and that further testwork and studies will be required to validate the full potential of Molulu and its stockpiles.
results.summary: Critical Metals announced preliminary metallurgical test results confirming 74% copper recovery from stockpile material at the Molulu Copper/Cobalt Project. While management describes these results as 'very encouraging' and an 'encouraging sign', no comparison to market expectations, analyst forecasts, or guidance targets is provided. The company explicitly notes these are early-stage preliminary results requiring further validation. No prior guidance was disclosed or compared against.

results.headline: Ottawa Heart (UOHI) Study Results Published in JHI
results.key_quote: Our study found that moving away from complex, multi-day patient-administered antibiotic regimens to a nurse-delivered, point-of-care photodisinfection treatment substantially reduced the compliance barrier. Achieving 93.3% compliance across both elective and emergency cases was accompanied by a significant drop in harvest conduit wound infections, underscoring the operational value of universal point-of-care decolonisation.
results.summary: Peer-reviewed publication in Journal of Hospital Infection demonstrates that Steriwave implementation achieved a 52.8% relative reduction in conduit harvest surgical site infections (from 3.6% to 1.7%) with 93.3% protocol compliance across 2,172 CABG procedures. The results show substantial operational improvements and clinical efficacy that exceed prior antibiotic-based regimens, with the lead surgeon highlighting the significance of these real-world clinical outcomes.
metrics_ahead: 52.8% relative reduction in conduit harvest surgical site infections
93.3% protocol compliance (up from 35.4%)
Secondary outcome: total surgical site infections declined from 9.1% to 5.9%
Statistically significant reduction in CHSSI (RR 0.20, 95% CI 0.05–0.72; p=0.014)
